pages.text:
Boils water into steam with up to 80 HU/t. Its Pressure tab picks the grade. On Auto it boils all the heat above 100°C: feed it more heat than it boils and it climbs toward its heat source's temperature, making better steam; underfeed it and it holds at 100°C making plain Steam.
Set to Steam, High-Pressure or Superheated, it heats without boiling until it reaches that grade's temperature, then holds there, making that grade at whatever rate its heat comes in.
If it cools into a lower grade, the steam it holds drops to that grade.
Water goes in on its input face (or from buckets), steam comes out of its output face.
